translations.web: At midnight, the man was startled and turned himself; and behold, a woman lay at his feet.
translations.bsb: At midnight, Boaz was startled, turned over, and there lying at his feet was a woman!
translations.kjv: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself: and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
translations.asv: And it came to pass at midnight, that the man was afraid, and turned himself; and, behold, a woman lay at his feet.
